cohort: A population-based sample of 581,844 women with singleton births and maternal heights of 140 cm and above, from the Swedish Pregnancy Register between 2011 and 2016.
finding: There was a decreasing risk of Caesarean section with increasing maternal height, an effect that remained after adjustment for other risk factors.
mod_finding: Increasing maternal height was associated with a decreasing risk of Caesarean section.
